metadata.description: Small Claude Code tools and skills by Mark Henry.

plugins.name: quota
plugins.description: Weekly quota left on Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions behind CLIProxyAPI vs an even-spend target, plus automatic account-weight rebalancing.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Download and clip videos with yt-dlp and ffmpeg, including past windows of streams that are still live.

plugins.name: flights
plugins.description: Scrape the Google Flights price calendar (cheapest fare per day across months) via browser-use.

plugins.name: sleep
plugins.description: Infer last night's bedtime and wake time from the Mac lid log, cross-checked against Chrome history.

plugins.name: gordian
plugins.description: Big-picture simplification audit for code that has accumulated complexity from many small edits.

plugins.name: figure
plugins.description: Turn a result into a self-contained figure: the claim as title, a qualifying caption, then the chart.

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Interview the user until a goal and its success bar are locked: definitions, denominators, threats, fallback bar, hard constraints. Use before any costly run, experiment, or multi-agent workflow.

plugins.name: prereg
plugins.description: Preregister a comparison before it runs: numeric predictions with fixed denominators, commit and diff stamped, arm-parity check, then predicted vs observed.

plugins.name: diverge
plugins.description: Diverge-then-converge adversarial design as Workflows: design (unanchored brainstorm, distinct families, prototype, red-team, repair, blind judge) and lite (five stances, a red-teamer each, a judge picks).

plugins.name: naming
plugins.description: Choose a name that travels: state its job, list the siblings it must not be confused with, brainstorm widely, test candidates against the classic rules, recommend one.

plugins.name: court
plugins.description: Hold court: present the user one decision at a time, each with the context needed to decide, choosing intelligently which comes next. Works for any kind of item.

plugins.name: amazon
plugins.description: Read the Amazon Cart (with same-day windowed items flagged), Amazon Fresh Cart and Whole Foods Market Cart from a dedicated agent Chrome; hand items to your real Chrome to add.

plugins.name: evals
plugins.description: LLM eval hygiene: judge (build and validate an LLM judge by Hamel Husain's critique shadowing, TPR/TNR on a held-out split) and audit (a subagent reads a stratified high/middle/low sample of scored items and flags scores too high, too low or broken, before a human looks).
